I will apply some bags of the subsidized NPK fertilizer because the soil in this area is sandy and tired, and without it the sorghum will not yield well. I am using seeds I saved from last season's harvest since improved seeds are too costly and hard to find in our local market. My family will do most of the work on this plot, but I will hire a few young men from the village to help with weeding when the rains start. We depend only on the rains here, so there is no irrigation, and I do not spray chemicals on sorghum because it is not worth the money for this crop.
